caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top made from two wide planks. The table is supported by four straight, vertical legs, each braced by two horizontal bars connecting the legs on each side, forming a rectangular support structure underneath. The wood is depicted in shades of brown, showing natural wood grain texture throughout the piece. The table corners are slightly beveled, and additional small horizontal wooden supports are visible beneath the tabletop on all four sides. The background is plain, off-white in color, with no additional objects or details, and some small handwritten text appears near the bottom right of the image.
title: Sanctuary Table
